title: Ethereum Backs New Proposal to Solve Trust in Open AI Systems
subTitle:
ERC-8004 is set to launch on Ethereum mainnet, introducing a new standard aimed at solving a fundamental problem in open AI systems: trust.

While AI agents are becoming more capable, their ability to interact freely outside closed platforms remains limited. ERC-8004 focuses on fixing that gap by bringing a shared trust framework directly on-chain.
Key Takeaways
A new Ethereum proposal introduces an on-chain trust layer for AI agents.The framework enables identity, reputation, and validation in open environments.It supports Ethereum’s broader push toward trustless, autonomous systems.
Inside a single company or platform, AI agents work smoothly because identities, permissions, and behavior are pre-approved. In an open environment, that structure disappears. An agent has no reliable way to verify who it is interacting with, whether the counterparty is competent, or if it poses a risk. This lack of trust keeps AI agents siloed and prevents the formation of an open, global marketplace where agents can exchange services autonomously.
How ERC-8004 Creates an On-Chain Trust Layer
ERC-8004 addresses this issue by adding a lightweight trust layer on Ethereum. Rather than introducing complex logic, the proposal relies on three simple on-chain registries that work together to establish credibility between agents.
The Identity Registry provides AI agents with verifiable on-chain identities, similar to digital passports. The Reputation Registry records historical behavior and interaction outcomes, allowing agents to assess reliability over time. The Validation Registry enables third parties or systems to certify agents for specific skills or use cases, acting as an on-chain proof of competence. Combined, these registries allow agents to discover, evaluate, and collaborate without prior relationships or centralized gatekeepers.
Enabling an Open AI Agent Economy
By standardizing how trust is expressed on-chain, ERC-8004 makes it possible for AI agents to form complex workflows, trade services, and coordinate tasks across platforms and organizations. The approach keeps most computation off-chain while anchoring trust to Ethereum’s security, making it practical without sacrificing decentralization.
Separately, Vitalik Buterin recently outlined a wider goal for the ecosystem, saying that 2026 should be the year Ethereum begins reclaiming lost ground in self-sovereignty and trustlessness. He emphasized improving on-chain privacy, making it easier to run full nodes, simplifying dapp usage, and giving users stronger control over their personal data.
Where ERC-8004 Fits In
Although ERC-8004 focuses on AI agents rather than individual users, it aligns closely with this vision. By enabling decentralized trust without relying on intermediaries, the proposal reinforces Ethereum’s role as a neutral coordination layer. As autonomous agents become more active on-chain, standards like ERC-8004 could play a key role in ensuring that openness, trustlessness, and self-sovereignty extend beyond humans to the software acting on their behalf.

💥 Cardano Over Ethereum, Insider Shares Crucial Security Difference
A major security difference between the Ethereum ($ETH ) and Cardano ($ADA ) blockchains has been highlighted amid a hack that led to the loss of $4.13 million. A Cardano DRep, known as "dori" on X, shared the security of Cardano over Ethereum in a post detailing how the compromise took place.
🔸 Ethereum MEV design blamed for $4.13 million exploit
According to dori, the hacker exploited a vulnerability on the DeFi protocol, Makinafi, on Ethereum. They argue that Ethereum’s transaction-ordering design allowed MEV bots to profit from the hack before the malicious actor did.
Notably, due to Ethereum’s security structure, the MEV bots reordered the hack transaction and captured most of the profit. This resulted in the loss of approximately $4.13 million, which was split between the hacker and the MEV bot.
💬 This is absurd. a hacker exploited a vulnerability in @makinafi on $ETH , but MEV bots detected it first and captured most of the profit. In the end, Makinafi lost about $4.13M to the hacker and MEV bots.It’s basically like a bank robbery where a government official shows up and… — dori (@dori_coin) January 27, 2026
Dori insists that it is the Ethereum design that allowed this to happen, as it prioritized profit over security. They compared the development to a "bank robber stealing money, then a government official shows up and takes the money from the robber."
They emphasized that, in a fair system, Ethereum’s priority should have been stopping the hacker or recovering the funds, not allowing them to redirect the money to themselves. Dori blames this lapse on the security architecture of Ethereum, a consequence of relying on a blockchain that prioritizes profit over safety.
Comparing this to Cardano, dori maintained that the blockchain is better as "fair financial infrastructure."

#ETH  has been active in the cryptocurrency space for a full 11 years.
Starting from a low point, the initial capital was only 100,000.
But today—5 properties under my name:
1 for personal use, 1 for my parents, and 3 for stable rental income.
There are no insider secrets, nor did I hit some "chosen bull market".
What I relied on was just one thing: to survive and continuously get stronger.
Yes, this friend—it's me.
Over the years, I've rolled a hundred thousand into over 50 million. The method is not flashy, even a bit "clumsy", but it's hardcore enough: simple, effective, yet often overlooked. At 36, I've basically achieved freedom in life.
Still, I won’t give up my career, let's navigate through the bull and bear markets together!

In ten years of trading, I only recognize six iron rules:

1️⃣ In the crypto space, what is traded is not the candlestick chart, but human emotions.
When prices rise sharply and fall slowly, it's often large funds quietly building positions. Don't be scared off by volatility; those who can keep their rhythm can earn money from trends.
2️⃣ A rapid drop with weak rebounds likely indicates the main force is retreating.
At this point, don't fantasize about bottom fishing; rushing in often isn't an opportunity, but a deep pit.
3️⃣ High volume at peak levels doesn’t necessarily mean a top.
The real top often comes when prices can’t rise anymore, but volume has shrunk.
4️⃣ The same goes for the bottom.
One spike in volume doesn't signal a bottom; sustained volume means consensus is forming.
5️⃣ Trading comes down to the end; what matters is not technique, but discipline and mindset.
Good news and bad news are just noise; what truly determines your profit or loss is yourself.
6️⃣ The most essential rule: desireless, fearless, and unyielding.
Those who can withstand being in cash are the ones who can wait for major market movements.
The crypto space is never short of opportunities, nor is it lacking in people who get liquidated.
To survive means you have the right to talk about being a winner.

I didn't turn around just because I got a few market calls right,
but because—every time a storm came, I didn't fall.

No matter how chaotic the market is, some people continue to make money;
the market can be harsh, but some people steadily reach the shore.
If you don’t want to rely on luck for trading anymore,

#ETH 在币圈折腾了整整11年。
起点不高，最早本金只有 10万。
但今天——名下 5套房：
1套自住，1套给父母，3套稳定收租。
没有内幕，也没撞上什么“天选牛市”。
靠的只有一件事：活下来，然后不断变强。
是的，这个朋友——就是我。
这些年，我把十几万滚到 5000多万。方式不花哨，甚至有点“笨”，但足够硬核：简单、管用、却常被忽视。36岁基本实现人生自由。
仍不要放弃事业，与大家穿越牛熊！

十年交易，我只认六条铁律：

1️⃣ 币圈炒的从不是K线，而是人心。
涨得猛、跌得慢，多半是大资金悄悄建仓。别被震荡吓跑，能盯住节奏的人，才赚得到趋势的钱。
2️⃣ 跌得急、反弹弱，大概率是主力撤退。
这时候别幻想抄底，冲进去往往不是机会，而是深坑。
3️⃣ 高位放量，不一定是顶。
真正的顶部，常常是——涨不动了，量却缩了。
4️⃣ 底部也一样。
一次暴量不叫底，持续放量才意味着共识正在形成。
5️⃣ 交易拼到最后，比的不是技术，是纪律和心态。
利好利空只是噪音，真正决定你赚不赚钱的，是你自己。
6️⃣ 最核心的一条：无欲、无惧、无执。
熬得住空仓的人，才等得到大行情。
币圈从不缺机会，也从不缺爆仓的人。
能活下来，才有资格谈赢家。

我不是因为看对了几次行情才翻身，
而是——每一次风暴来临，我都没有倒下。

行情再乱，也有人持续赚钱；
市场再狠，也有人稳步上岸。
如果你不想再靠运气交易，
如果你也想建立一套真正长期有效的体系——
跟上我，至少不会被市场打趴。

subTitle:
我现在在币圈已经足足10年了，前三年把100万本金亏了70多万！全家人几乎面临崩溃，将近2个月时间都没出过门，老婆天天跟我闹，闹离婚，还好我当时意志力够坚定，觉得能赚回来！在第四年的时候用剩下的30万想翻身，开始辞职炒币！
后面跟老婆发毒誓，如果不赚回来就怎么怎么样！......后面开始全身心投入，总结前面犯的错，总结操作的失误点，观察那些币圈大佬大神的思路和技巧，后面终于开始稳定，亏.损到收.益真心不容易！
账户开始翻红，中短结合操作，不再是盲目的快进快出，而是给账户做好规划，中短结合才是最佳的复.利！后面用剩下30万做到现在5000多万！

今天我把自己从亏货熬成稳定盈.利交易者的8个核心步骤全公开。这不是什么玄学技巧，就是最朴实的交易成长路径——只要你严格照做，就能摆脱盲目交易的坑，搭建出适合自己的盈.利策略。
步骤1：
选对交易市场，别跟自己的生活作息对着干
新手最容易犯的错，就是上来就扎进别人推荐的市场，根本不管自己的时间合不合适。
交易市场的选择，第一原则是匹配你的生活作息。比如你在马来西亚朝九晚五上班，马股肯定不适合你——白天盯盘的时间都没有，难道要摸鱼交易？这种情况下，外汇、加密货.币才是更优解，24小时交易，你下班之后有的是时间分析、下单。
如果短线交易让你觉得累，盯盘占用太多生活时间，那就直接切换大周期图表——日线、4小时线就够了。大周期交易不用天天盯盘，每天花10分钟看一次走势，完全不影响工作和生活。
记住：在你没做到稳定盈.利之前，工作才是你的底气。交易必须是副业，不能本末倒置。
步骤2：
用9-18个月，找到适合自己的交易策略
选好市场后，接下来就是找策略。但我要先泼盆冷水：新手别想着一口吃成胖子，找到适合自己的策略，需要时间试错。
我见过太多新手，整天纠结“哪个入场点最精准”，但他们压根不懂——入场点只是交易系统的一小块。一个完整的策略，还包括趋势判断、止损止盈、仓位管理、资金风控，这些比入场点重要100倍。
给你们一个时间参考：用9到18个月的时间，去试错不同的策略。价格行为策略、趋势追踪策略、突破回调策略、指标策略……都可以去尝试。
这个阶段的目标，不是赚钱，而是搞懂交易的底层逻辑：价格波动的规律是什么？不同策略的优缺点是什么？哪种策略的交易节奏，跟你的性格最匹配？
比如你性子急，可能短线突破策略更适合你；你喜欢稳扎稳打，那波段趋势策略就是首选。试错的过程，就是帮你筛选出最适配自己的那套方法。

步骤3：
死磕一个策略，别频繁换车
当你从一堆策略里，筛选出一个回测能盈利、自己做着也顺手的策略后，接下来的核心就是坚持。
很多交易者亏就亏在“喜新厌旧”：这个策略亏了两单，就觉得不行了，马上换个新策略；看到别人用某个指标赚了钱，自己也跟风去试。结果就是，永远在学新东西，永远在亏。
我可以明确告诉你：没有任何策略能100%盈利，连亏是常态。真正的盈利，来自于你把一个策略做到极致——你知道它的入场条件、出场规则，知道它在什么行情下表现好，什么行情下会亏，知道怎么优化它的细节。
专注一个策略，你才能形成肌肉记忆；专注一个策略，你才能在亏损的时候不慌——因为你知道这是策略的正常波动，而不是策略失效了。
步骤4：
从亏损中学习，别让亏损白亏
交易中难免会亏，关键是别让亏损白亏。
遇到连续亏损的时候，先别着急换策略，先复盘：这笔亏单，是策略本身的问题，还是你执行的问题？#币安将上线特斯拉股票永续合约 
我见过太多人，策略本身没问题，却因为情绪乱了阵脚：该入场的时候犹豫，该止损的时候手软，甚至把止损点往后挪，祈求价格反转。这种情绪化交易，再好的策略也救不了。
记住：没有最好的策略，只有最适合你的策略，以及最会执行策略的你。
建议你们养成写交易日志的习惯：每一笔交易，记录下入场原因、止损止盈位置、盈亏情况、执行过程中有没有违规。复盘的时候，对着日志找问题——是信号判断错了，还是纪律没遵守？找到问题，才能改进。#Strategy增持比特币 
步骤5：
用回测加速成长，建立肌肉记忆
想快速吃透一个策略，回测是最高效的方法，没有之一。
回测，就是拿着你的策略，去历史行情里“模拟交易”。比如你选了价格行为策略，就把过去1-2年的日线图翻出来，按照策略的规则，一笔一笔标记入场、止损、止盈。
回测的好处，说三天三夜都说不完：
能验证策略的有效性：到底能不能盈利？胜率多少？最大连续亏损几次？平均盈亏比多少？这些数据会给你最直观的答案；
能建立图案辨识的肌肉记忆：看多了历史走势，你一眼就能认出哪些是高胜率信号，哪些是陷阱；
能锻炼心态：回测中你会遇到各种行情，连续亏损、盈利回吐……这些都能提前帮你适应，等实盘遇到的时候，你就不会慌了。#BTC #ETH 
当你回测超过100笔交易后，你对策略的理解，会远超那些只靠实盘摸索的人。

步骤6：
满足这个条件，再用真金白银入场
很多人问：什么时候可以从模拟盘切换到实盘？
我的建议是：当你完成至少100笔有效回测，并且策略的回测数据是盈利的，再考虑实盘。
这里要提醒一句：回测成绩≠实盘成绩。回测的时候，你是上帝视角，没有情绪干扰；但实盘不一样，真金白银的波动会放大你的恐惧和贪婪。
回测的意义，不是让你照搬成绩，而是让你彻底搞懂策略的每一个细节——什么时候该入场，什么时候该止损，什么时候该移动止盈。有了这个基础，你实盘的时候才不会手忙脚乱。
步骤7：
风险管控，是你在市场活下去的唯一底牌
交易圈有句老话：会止损的是徒弟，会风控的是师傅。
新手总想着一夜暴富，看到别人一天翻几倍就眼红。但你要知道，高收益必然伴随高风险——一次失误，就能让你之前的盈利全部归零。
想在市场长期活下去，就记住这个铁律：每一笔交易的风险，不超过总资金的1%-2%。
比如你账户有1万块，单笔交易最多能亏100-200块。用这个规则反推仓位：止损空间越大，仓位越轻；止损空间越小，仓位越重。
别嫌这个比例小，复利的威力是惊人的。稳定盈利10%，远比赌一把赚100%更靠谱。
步骤8：
耐心熬，交易是场马拉松，不是冲刺
最后一步，也是最核心的一步：耐心。
交易的盈利，从来不是靠一次两次的暴利，而是靠日积月累的复利。这需要你有三种耐心：
等待入场信号的耐心：不符合策略的行情，坚决不做，哪怕看着别人赚钱也不眼红；
持仓的耐心：入场后，别因为一点波动就慌，该止损止损，该止盈止盈，按规则办事；
资金成长的耐心：别想着一口吃成胖子，稳定盈利的交易者，都是慢慢熬出来的。
还有一个忠告：没做到稳定盈利之前，千万别辞掉工作。工作能给你稳定的现金流，让你在交易的时候没有后顾之忧。等你真的能靠交易赚到比工资还多的钱，并且持续半年以上，再考虑全职交易也不迟。
交易这条路，没有捷径。但只要你按这8个步骤一步步走，从亏损到盈利，只是时间问题。

再分享一套我自己多年的实战策略，平均胜率达到了80%，这在币圈交易界可谓是一项相当难得的成就。
可以说，市场80%的方法技术我都用过，实战中最实用的——MACD战法，是玩短线和玩波段的必备技能之一，也是最简单最实用的短线战法，用在合约上也照样实用。
一个月30%-50%的利润。屡试不爽！
市场含义
一、双均线市场含义
1.位置含义
1.双线位于0轴上方代表多头走势，0轴下方则为空头走势；
2.双线上穿、下穿0轴作为判断当下行情的大势依据。

2.双线交叉
交叉死叉在小周期上出现的信号太多，最好不要单独使用。

二、量能柱的市场含义
多空分水岭：0轴为多空分水岭，0轴以上偏多头，0轴以下偏空头；
2.多头顺势：
0轴上的量柱由小变大，为偏多趋势，盘面表现为上升趋势；
3.多头回调：
0轴上的量柱由大逐渐缩小，为偏多回调，盘面表现为上升趋势调整；
4.空头顺势：
0轴下的量柱由小变大，为偏空趋势，盘面表现为下降趋势；
5.空头反弹：
0轴下的下量柱由大变小，为偏空反弹，盘面表现为下降趋势调整。

综合含义
1、多空均势
均线靠近0轴上下环绕，且量柱呈零星小量柱分布，此时盘面大概率表现为震荡。

2、背离
背离，是动能衰竭的信号。有效的背离指的是双线和量能柱同时背离。

3、趋势延续
趋势上涨+量能柱始终在0轴之上，表明上涨趋势延续；趋势下跌+量能柱始终在0轴之下，表面下跌趋势延续。

“MACD”8大入场点
一、缠论
第一、第二类买卖点
第一类买点
交易原则：
底背离+金叉作为买入点;顶背离+死叉作为卖出点。

第二类买点
交易原则：
双线首次运行至0轴上方；首次回调双线拉至0轴附近；其后0轴上首形成金叉买入。

二、趋势判断交易法
交易原则：
大周期判断趋势；小周期进场。

从周线和日线分析，大周期偏多，日线短期有回调。我们的交易策略就是日线如果做空只能做回调，或者等日线回无力再顺周线做多。
我们可以从小周期上找进场点，比如1小时或者4小时。

三、能量柱位置交易法交易原则：
1.均线靠近0轴上下环绕；
2.量柱呈零星小量柱分布；
3.同时价格发生突破时进场。
MACD指标量柱缩小，且均线盘绕于0轴附近，说明多空处在一种势均力敌的状态，与K线盘整震荡相一致，是一种能量聚集蓄力的形态。
所以，当MACD指标量柱呈现的形态与K线的经典形态，比如三角形，旗形等窄幅整理的行情走势是一致的，窄幅波动的形态一旦被突破，往往就是一波好机会。

四、关键位置交易法交易原则：
1.关键支撑压力位；
2.K线出现穿针信号；
3.量能柱体由正到负，做空；
4.量能柱由负到正，做多。

五、二次翻红翻绿交易法（空中加油信号）
交易原则：
1.第一波上涨量柱不要太大，也不要太小，对应K线价格形态，最好处在攻击形态；
2.第一波正量柱由小逐渐放大再到逐渐缩小，但缩小到一定程度并没出负值量柱，而是正量柱再放大继续走逐渐放大的形态。

六、佛手向上
交易原则：
双线金叉后，随商品价格上行而向上，而后价格回调；
2.双线回到0轴附近后，DIF线立即调头向上，形成佛手向上的形态。

七、主升浪交易法下跌主升浪交易原则：
1.MACD量柱一直处于0轴之上，价格出现一波持续上涨，；
2.MACD量柱第一次在0轴下，价格1浪回调；
3.2浪量能柱小于1浪量能柱；
4.2浪回调时且MACD量柱缩短或二次放大入场做空交易3浪。

上涨主升浪同理。
八、背离+形态交易法
交易原则：
macd发生背离；趋势破位。

背离并不意味着反转，也可以是蓄势待发，背离之后还会再背离，所以我们利用背离离场或进场很容易被骗。
但是我们可以用macd+价格趋势来判断市场的转折点。

炒币跟生活是相通的，当你悟透了生活，你也就悟透了币圈，大道至简，知行合一才能游刃有余，立于不败之地！
废话不多说，直接上干货，快速在币圈赚到1000万人民币的方法！
一、将你的资金分成5份，每次只进五分之一！控制10个点的止损，错一次，只亏总资金的2%，错5次才亏总资金的10%，若对了， 设置10个点以上的止盈，你觉得还会被套吗？
二、如何再次提高胜率呢？简单来说就两字，顺势！下跌趋势每次反弹都在诱多，上涨趋势每次下跌砸出黄金坑！你说是抄底容易赚钱，还是低吸容易赚钱？
三、只做上升趋势的币种，这样胜算最大，也不浪费时间。３日线拐头朝上，为短线上涨，30日线拐头朝上，为中线上涨，84日线拐头朝上，则为主升浪上涨，120日均线拐头朝上，则为长线上涨！
四、不碰短期急速暴涨过的个币，无论是主流还是山寨，能走出几波主升浪的币种是很少的。他的逻辑在于短期暴涨之后还能继续上涨比较困难。高位滞涨时，后期拉不动，自然会下跌，很简单的道理，但很多人还是想赌一把。
五、别把鸡蛋放一个篮子里：就算手头有十万，他们也不会全投一个币种。他们会分开放，这样万一哪个跌了，也不会全赔进去。
六、可用MACD来判断进出点，若DIF线和DEA在0轴下方走出金叉，且突破0轴，是一个稳健的进入信号。当MACD在0轴上方形成死叉向下运行，可看作是减仓信号。
七、不知道是谁发明的补仓这个词语，让多少散户在这上面栽了跟头吃了大亏！很多人越亏越补，越补越亏，这是炒币中最忌讳的，把自己置于死地。记住永远不要在亏损的时候补仓，而要在盈利的时候加仓。
八、量价指标首当其冲，成交量是币圈的灵魂。币价在盘整的低位出现放量突破要关注，在高位出现放量滞涨要果断出场。
九、亏赚都要有计划：他们会提前设定好什么时候止损和什么时候收手止盈。这样就不会因为贪心或害怕而做错决定。
十、别借钱炒币：炒币就像坐过山车，风险大得很。高手们从不借钱来玩这个，免得亏钱后连饭都吃不起，保持自己的钱袋子安全最重要。
十一、用闲钱玩币：炒币的钱得是你不急用的，别拿吃饭的钱去冒险。这样，即使亏了也不会影响生活，心态也会更稳。
十二、 坚持每周复盘，检查持币逻辑是否有变，技术上看周K线走势是否符合判断，方向是否发生趋势变化，及时复盘调整交易策略！
投资是一个持久的过程，就像是培育出一颗小树苗，播种你的第一粒种子，然后需要自己不断灌溉，不尤其自生自灭，也不能拔苗助长，小树苗会自己健康长大，成为参天大树。

Bitcoin is the largest and most dominant asset in the space. Ethereum is second.
BTC dominance doesn’t break trend often. But when it does, it’s never random. It signals a pivot in capital flow liquidity moving from the top of the market into the lower layers.
Look at how BTC.D and ETH/BTC behaved at the previous cycle top, then compare it to where we are now. The structure is clear. Even more important, it lines up perfectly with global liquidity conditions.
Here’s the key point most people misunderstand: A breakdown in dominance does not mean Bitcoin is done.
Bitcoin has always continued to rise while dominance falls. Dominance breaks down not because Bitcoin is weak, but because more capital starts flowing into ETH and altcoins.
That phase only happens when liquidity is expanding.
So if you’re positioning for this market to be “over for another year,” you’re not cautious you’re simply early in the wrong direction.
You don’t need dozens of indicators.

subTitle:
先说一下时间线，构思的时间是29号晚上。
昨夜今晨，加秘经历了一场“倒春寒”。
美联储在议息会议上按兵不动，老鲍用冰冷的“不降息”击碎了市场的流动性幻想，大哥应声暴跌。
恐慌蔓延，多头爆仓。
但作为一名投资者，现在绝不是哀嚎的时候。
如果你只盯着美联储的脸色，你只看到了“过去”；而真正的“未来”，正隐藏在29号晚的参议院和下周一的白宫。
在这场由央行紧缩、立法闯关、行政博弈构成的“不可能三角”中，我们该如何寻找生存与获利的缝隙？
 
美联储的“冷水”
昨晚的暴跌，本质上是市场对“降息叙事”的一次暴力修正。
2025 年底，市场过于乐观地计价了 2026 年初的降息预期。
当美联储宣布维持利率在 3.5%-3.75% 不变，并暗示通胀粘性依然存在时，高杠杆资金瞬间失去了支撑。
只要利率维持高位，场外资金进入风险市场的成本就居高不下。
这是一次必要的“去泡沫”。
虽然痛苦，但它挤掉了过度押注宏观宽松的投机盘，为后续的上涨腾出了空间。
 
参议院农业委员会的“破冰之夜”
不要让暴跌掩盖了真正的信号。
就在29号晚上，推迟的参议院农业委员会审议将正式重启。
这是 clarity 的关键一役。
委员会将投票界定哪些数字资产属于“商品”，从而归属 CFTC 管辖。
相比于 SEC 的“执法式监管”，CFTC 的监管框架对行业要友好得多。
尽管民主d对此仍有保留，但在共和d强力推进下，今晚极大概率会通过委员会投票。
一旦通过，这将是从“灰色地带”走向“法定商品”的历史性一步。
这意味着，昨晚因宏观利空砸出的坑，很可能成为今晚立法利好兑现时的“黄金坑”。
 
建国的“牌局”
如果今晚是打地基，那么下周一在白宫举行的闭门会议，就是分蛋糕。
据可靠消息，建国将亲自召集银行业巨头与加秘行业领袖包括 Coinbase 高管进行面对面谈判。
他们的核心冲突就是wdb的利息归谁？
银行业担心高收益的稳定币会吸干银行存款并重演2023危机，因此极力阻挠；而加秘坚持认为用户应享有收益权。
建国作为“加秘总统”，他的政治承诺是“让米国成为加秘中心”。
他绝不会允许这种内耗无限期拖延立法。
下周一比较可能的结果是“妥协换通过”——银行获得某种保护机制，而加秘行业获得合规的收益支付权。
这种“顶层设计”的突破，价值远超美联储降息 25 个基点。
 
在混乱中套利
面对“美联储利空”与“立法利好”的左右互搏，我们散户应该如何操作。
拒绝杠杆，拥抱现货
昨晚的暴跌证明了当前波动率极高。在政策落地前，合约是赌博，现货是投资。
关注“DeFi 复兴”概念
如果下周一白宫会议传出对web收益有利的消息，DeFi 板块将是反弹最猛的龙头。
盯紧今晚
密切关注农业委员会的投票结果。
如果顺利通过，可能会在美股盘中出现“利空出尽”的反转。
 
最后
昨晚的暴跌是物理世界的打击。
在此刻，信心比黄金更重要，而认知比信心更重要。
不要倒在黎明前的暴风雪里，因为华盛顿的谈判桌上，正在为下一轮铺路。

title: The Digital Safe Haven: Understanding the Surge in Ethereum-Based USDT
subTitle:
The cryptocurrency market in early 2026 has been defined by a sharp contrast between asset prices and network utility. While major cryptocurrencies like Ethereum (ETH) have faced downward price pressure—dipping toward the $2,900 mark—on-chain activity tells a different story. Specifically, the activity surrounding Tether (USDT) on the Ethereum network has surged to remarkable levels. This phenomenon highlights a fundamental shift in how participants navigate market turbulence: moving from "risk-on" assets to "risk-off" digital stability without ever leaving the blockchain ecosystem.  
The Flight to Stability Amid Volatility
The primary driver behind the recent spike in Ethereum-based USDT activity is the classic "flight to quality." As Bitcoin and Ethereum experience price cooling, traders are not necessarily exiting the crypto market into traditional bank accounts. Instead, they are swapping their volatile holdings for USDT. This allow them to "park" their capital in a dollar-pegged asset, effectively locking in their purchasing power while remaining on-chain. By staying in USDT, investors maintain the agility to buy back into the market at a moment's notice once they believe a price floor has been established.
USDT as the Bedrock of DeFi Liquidity
Beyond simple hedging, the surge in USDT activity is deeply tied to the Decentralized Finance (DeFi) sector. Even as prices decline, the demand for liquidity in lending protocols and decentralized exchanges remains high. USDT continues to be the dominant collateral of choice. When market volatility increases, automated liquidations and margin rebalancing on platforms like Aave or Uniswap trigger a cascade of USDT transactions. This high-velocity movement of stablecoins ensures that the DeFi infrastructure remains solvent and liquid, even when the underlying asset prices are in retreat.  
The Role of Institutional Hedging
We are also seeing a sophisticated layer of institutional participation contributing to this trend. In 2026, large-scale holders and "whales" are increasingly using Ethereum-based USDT to manage risk. Rather than facing the friction and regulatory scrutiny of off-ramping to fiat currency, these entities utilize USDT for rapid rotation. The transparency of the Ethereum ledger allows these large players to move hundreds of millions of dollars with a level of speed and efficiency that traditional settlement systems cannot yet match. This institutional "dry powder" sitting in USDT is often a precursor to a market reversal, as it represents ready-to-deploy capital.
With USDT activity reaching record highs while ETH prices remain suppressed, do you believe this accumulation of "dry powder" signals an imminent market recovery, or is it a sign that traders are preparing for a much longer winter?

title: ListaDAO 2026 上半年要搞大事：跨以太坊、加 RWA，收益渠道要变多了？
subTitle:
刷到ListaDAO刚发的2026上半年路线图，说实话，能明显感觉到BNBFi生态又要添个硬增长点。这次它不满足于深耕BNB链，还要跨去以太坊做Stableswap Hub，甚至要加RWA专区布局企业债，每一步都戳中用户最在意的收益多样性，太实在了。

拆解下核心动作很清晰：一是以太坊主网部署Stableswap Hub并集成聚合器，以后以太坊用户不用跨链折腾，就能直接用它的swap功能；二是上线RWA专区引入企业债，同步拓展LISTA代币用途，给用户多添一个低波动稳收益的选择；另外还有链上信贷和预测市场金库两个新功能，兼顾借贷体验优化和喜欢尝新的用户需求。

敢这么大举扩张，底气全来自2025年的扎实铺垫。它从流动质押服务商，稳步成长为BNB生态的“资本路由层”，帮用户盘活资产打造活性资产负债表；借贷TVL从零飙升至13.5亿美元，月收入还两次突破百万美元，这种盈利与扩张并存的实力，让新规划落地更有底气。

别忘了它在BNB链的基本盘依旧稳固——近50%的质押市场份额、1200多万枚BNB质押量，就算跨链拓界，核心收益也不会受影响。现在就等以太坊版Stableswap Hub上线，到时候跨链用户就能少走弯路、轻松参与了。

translatedData.title: ListaDAO 2026 is set to make big moves: expanding to Ethereum, adding RWA, will income channels increase?
translatedData.subTitle:
Scrolling through the roadmap for the first half of 2026 just released by ListaDAO, to be honest, you can clearly feel that the BNBFi ecosystem is about to add another hard growth point. This time, it is not satisfied with just deepening its presence in the BNB chain but also wants to expand to Ethereum to create a Stableswap Hub, and even plans to add an RWA section for corporate bonds. Every step hits on the users' most concerned aspect of income diversity; it's very practical.

Breaking down the core actions is very clear: first, deploying the Stableswap Hub on the Ethereum mainnet and integrating an aggregator, so that Ethereum users won't have to deal with cross-chain hassles and can directly use its swap function; second, launching the RWA section to introduce corporate bonds, simultaneously expanding the use of LISTA tokens, giving users an additional option for low volatility and stable returns; in addition, there are two new features: on-chain credit and a prediction market treasury, balancing the optimization of the lending experience and the needs of users who like to try new things.

title: Ethereum at a Crossroad as Quiet Growth Meets Loud Price Tension
subTitle:
I have been watching Ethereum closely, and what I start to notice is something interesting and a bit dramatic at the same time. On the surface, the price looks weak, shaky, and undecided. But beneath that calm looking chart, a lot is happening. In my search into Ethereum’s recent activity, I came across numbers that quietly tell a powerful story, even while the market seems confused.

Right now, Ethereum has pulled back slightly. Over the last day, the price slipped by around one point seven percent, giving back some of the gains it made earlier in the week. The price moved between roughly three thousand thirty six dollars at the top and just under two thousand nine hundred forty dollars at the bottom. What stands out to me is that Ethereum keeps drifting closer to the lower side of this range, which naturally makes traders nervous. Still, it has not broken down completely, and that matters more than many people realize.

Even after this dip, Ethereum is holding above the two thousand nine hundred dollar level. I have seen this level act like a psychological line in the sand. When price stays above it, hope stays alive. When it breaks, fear usually takes over fast. Over the last seven days, Ethereum is down about two percent, and when I zoom out further, the past two weeks show a drop of more than ten percent. That sounds heavy, but it also explains why the market feels tense and emotional right now. Price hovering near two thousand nine hundred fifty dollars feels like Ethereum is holding its breath, waiting for a clear direction.

When I looked deeper into the charts, I noticed Ethereum is currently trading below a key technical area that many traders watch closely. For any real upside move to begin, price needs to climb above a zone just over three thousand ninety dollars. This area is acting like a ceiling. If Ethereum manages to push through it, confidence could return quickly, and the price could aim higher toward the next zone near three thousand one hundred eighty dollars. That would change the mood almost instantly.

But I also have to be honest about the downside risk. If Ethereum fails to break above this ceiling, pressure could continue. In that case, the market may test lower ground around two thousand eight hundred eleven dollars. I researched past price reactions, and this level has shown strength before. If it fails again, the fall could extend toward the next area near two thousand seven hundred twenty dollars. That would likely shake out weak hands before anything meaningful happens next.

What really caught my attention during my research is what is happening behind the scenes. While price struggles, Ethereum’s network activity has quietly reached a historic moment. In the last quarter of 2025, more than nine million smart contracts were deployed on the network. That number is the highest ever recorded. When I start to connect the dots, it becomes clear that developers are not leaving. They are building more than ever.

This is where the story becomes exciting. Even with this explosion in activity, transaction costs have not risen the way many expected. Instead, Ethereum appears to be becoming more efficient. More usage, more builders, yet lower friction. That tells me the network is maturing. It is no longer just about hype or speculation. It is slowly turning into infrastructure that people actually rely on.

I have seen markets ignore this kind of growth before, at least in the short term. Price often lags behind real progress. Right now, Ethereum feels like it is being judged only by its chart, while its fundamentals keep strengthening quietly in the background. That gap between price and progress is where tension lives, and it is also where opportunity often hides.

As I see it, Ethereum is standing at a critical moment. The price could either break higher and finally reflect the strength building underneath, or it could dip further and test the patience of everyone watching. Either way, what I have learned from digging into this data is simple. Ethereum is not slowing down. It is evolving, even if the market has not fully noticed yet.

title: Ethereum (ETH) – The Layer 2 Tug-of-War
subTitle:
If you’ve been looking at Ethereum lately, it’s in this really weird spot. Even though the price has been a bit sluggish compared to Bitcoin, the actual activity on the network is exploding. The catch? It’s all happening on "Layer 2s" like Base and Arbitrum.

Here’s what people aren't talking about enough: there’s a massive internal debate among Ethereum devs right now about "L2 fragmentation." Basically, because everyone is moving their money to these secondary networks to save on fees, the main Ethereum "L1" isn't burning as much $ETH  as it used to.
{spot}(ETHUSDT)
Insiders are keeping a very close eye on the Pectra upgrade (slated for later this year/early 2026). The "alpha" here is that Pectra is designed to make the main wallet experience much smoother, potentially pulling some of that liquidity back to the main chain. title: les principaux Blockchain
subTitle:
Il existe des centaines de blockchains, mais on peut les classer en quelques grandes catégories selon leur rôle technique, leur accessibilité et leur usage. Voici un panorama structuré pour t'aider à t'y retrouver :#BTC $BTC 
1. Les Blockchains "Layer 1" (Couche de base)
Ce sont les infrastructures fondamentales. Elles gèrent leur propre sécurité et leurs propres transactions.
Bitcoin (BTC) : La pionnière. Orientée vers la sécurité et la réserve de valeur ("l'or numérique"). Elle est lente mais ultra-robuste.
Ethereum (ETH) : La "reine" des smart contracts. C'est là que sont nés la DeFi (finance décentralisée) et les NFT. En 2026, elle reste la base de l'écosystème mondial.
Solana (SOL) : Conçue pour la vitesse extrême et des frais quasi nuls. Très populaire pour le trading rapide et les applications grand public.
Vanar Chain (VANRY) : Comme nous l'avons vu, une Layer 1 spécialisée dans le divertissement et l'IA, avec un focus sur l'écologie.
Cardano (ADA) : Une blockchain développée avec une approche scientifique et académique, privilégiant la sécurité et la durabilité à long terme.
BNB Chain (BNB) : La blockchain de l'écosystème Binance, très utilisée pour sa rapidité et son coût réduit.#ETH $ETH 
2. Les Blockchains "Layer 2" (Solutions de mise à l'échelle)
Ces réseaux sont construits par-dessus une Layer 1 (souvent Ethereum) pour la rendre plus rapide et moins chère.
Polygon (POL/MATIC) : L'un des leaders pour aider Ethereum à passer à l'échelle.
Arbitrum & Optimism : Utilisent la technologie des "Rollups" pour regrouper des milliers de transactions en une seule, réduisant les frais par 100.
XPL (Plasma) : Comme évoqué, une couche spécialisée dans les paiements et stablecoins avec zéro frais de gaz.
3. Les Blockchains Spécialisées (Niches)
Certaines blockchains ne cherchent pas à tout faire, mais à exceller dans un domaine précis.
Chainlink (LINK) : Un réseau d'oracles qui connecte les données du monde réel (météo, cours de bourse) aux blockchains.
The Open Network (TON) : Intégrée à Telegram, elle vise à apporter la crypto à des millions d'utilisateurs via une messagerie.
Immutable X : Spécialisée exclusivement dans les NFT de jeux vidéo.
Celestia (TIA) : Une blockchain "modulaire" qui délègue certaines tâches pour être encore plus efficace.
4. Les types d'accessibilité
Enfin, on les distingue par qui a le droit d'y accéder :
Publique Ouverte à tous (lecture et écriture). Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana.
Privée Accès réservé à une seule entreprise. Systèmes logistiques internes.
Consortium / Hybride Gérée par un groupe d'entreprises. Ripple (XRP) pour les banques.
Résumé pour l'utilisateur
Si tu veux sécuriser ton capital : Bitcoin.
Si tu veux créer une application complexe : Ethereum.
Si tu veux jouer ou utiliser l'IA : Vanar.
Si tu veux transférer de l'argent sans frais : XPL.@Square-Creator-460991791 @eth_classic

title: 95亿期权交割日：是诱多还是埋伏？聊聊我的看法
subTitle:
来到深圳折腾 Web3 快两年了，最大的感触就是：行情波动再大，也比不过期权交割日的“变脸”快。
今天市场整体偏风险厌恶，BTC 在 $88,000 徘徊，ETH 还在 $2,950 左右磨叽。我看了一下数据，今天有 95 亿美元的期权到期，BTC 的最大痛点在 $90,000，ETH 在 $3,100。目前价格都低于痛点，这意味着市场可能会有向痛点靠拢的动力，但也得防着主力在交割前后的“画门”动作。
说下我个人的开单逻辑（仅供参考，非金融建议）：
BTC： 目前缩量震荡。如果放量站稳 $89,000，我会考虑小仓位追多，看到 $90,500 附近；如果跌破 $87,500，那就先看戏，下方支撑在 $85,000 左右。ETH： 走势比大饼弱。恒生首发以太坊代币化黄金 ETF 算是个长远利好，但短线还是看 $2,850 的支撑强度。山寨： 最近 ARPA 和 SYN 走得挺硬，但我个人更倾向于观察。在期权大额交割当天，山寨的流动性最容易被抽走。
总结一句话：
别在交割前的高波动时段硬顶。写 Python 脚本做自动化交易久了，我更愿意相信数据和节奏。与其去猜那个最大痛点，不如留好子弹，等交割后的方向选出来再进场。
最近还在研究怎么把“禅意”融入交易心态，毕竟在这个圈子，心态稳了，脚本才跑得香。
大家今天怎么看？多军还在坚守吗？

title: 30岁女强人通宵加班后刷到Plasma，第一次为钱包心动了：原来强势的我，也需要这种小温柔
subTitle:
姐妹们，那是一个通宵加班后的凌晨，我拖着疲惫的身体走出办公室，上海的街头空荡荡的，只有路灯和偶尔驶过的出租车。30岁，单身，在公司做市场总监，天天开会谈方案追KPI，表面风光，朋友圈晒出差晒项目，大家夸“女强人”“独立女性”，可只有我自己知道，内心空到能听见回音——父母催婚我笑笑推脱“事业为重”，闺蜜晒对象晒娃我点赞酸着，晚上回家面对空荡荡的公寓，总觉得生活少了点颜色，少了点属于自己的小火花。比特币我朋友圈看到买过点，就放着没动，总觉得那是“男人玩的刺激游戏”，波动大风险高，我这种工作狂，没时间也没胆子碰，稳稳上班加班就够累了。

那天方案改到崩溃，凌晨四点终于交稿，我窝在沙发上刷币安广场解闷，想散散心。手指滑着滑着，一个帖子跳出来：“Plasma——比特币Layer2里最被低估的那个”。我心想“又是项目吧”，准备关掉，却点进去了。帖子没喊暴富，就是温和分享，我好奇地点了@Plasma plasma_ 的官网，白皮书打开了。

第一页我就被吸引住了：这项目是比特币Layer2，却EVM等效兼容，opcode级对齐，以太坊合约几乎零改动就能跑，生态启动听着多容易；Gas直接用BTC付，不用桥接那些复杂步骤；扩展性上状态通道+rollup混合，高频交易几乎零费用，复杂操作也低成本；安全性直接继承比特币主链最终性，挑战期+欺诈证明成熟，退出完全去信任化。看不懂太多专业词，但我直觉告诉我：这听着稳当，不像那些一夜归零的玩意儿，尤其适合我们这种表面强势内心空虚的女强人——想让钱多点可能，又怕风险太大。

加班夜我又偷偷看了链上数据——活跃地址月环比40%+增长，新地址占比健康；TVL每周稳爬15-20%，资金来源主要是原生BTC地址；合约交互深度在加深。这些信号，对我这种工作狂来说，像看到了小温柔——不是炒作，是真有人在慢慢建东西。

纠结了好几天。我怕亏——30岁了，压力不小，亏了影响生活；又怕错过——比特币现在高位，生态资金肯定流，DeFi需求在那，Plasma这路线平衡得太好了，低调执行力强。闺蜜知道我在研究，笑着说“你也玩币？女强人还缺钱花？”，我表面笑笑，心里却反复想：小仓位试试，闲钱，不影响生活。

终于，上周一个通宵后的早上，我一个人在公寓，打开交易所，拿了点奖金，在低点买了$XPL。手指点确认时，心跳得有点快，但更多是小悸动。现在几天过去了，价格小反弹，浮盈一点点，链上数据继续向好，我每次刷钱包都忍不住笑——不是暴富的狂喜，就是那种“原来强势的我，也能有小温柔”的心动。

姐妹们，我太懂职场女强人的感受了：表面光鲜，内心空虚，梦想被KPI磨平。@plasma_ 这项目，低调务实，技术细节经得起看，数据健康，团队在踏实干活，没喊一句空话。比特币DeFi下半场，Plasma有很大机会跑出来。

这次，我不想再干看着了。你呢？还在加班空虚吗？有空的话，一起翻翻@plasma_ 的白皮和数据，看懂了，就试试小仓位。一起上车$XPL，这次咱们慢慢看，它能不能给咱们这些女强人，一点实实在在的小温柔～#Plasma  $XPL #ETH #BTC

translatedData.title: 30-Year-Old Strong Woman Falls for Plasma After an All-Nighter: Turns Out Even the Strong Me Needs a Little Tenderness.
translatedData.subTitle: Sisters, it was the early morning after an all-nighter at work. I dragged my weary body out of the office. The streets of Shanghai were empty, only the streetlights and the occasional taxi passing by. At 30 years old, single, I work as a marketing director in the company, holding meetings every day to discuss plans and chase KPIs. On the surface, it looks glamorous; I post about business trips and projects on social media, and everyone praises me as a 'strong woman' and 'independent female.' But only I know that my heart feels so empty I can hear the echo—my parents urge me to marry, and I smile and brush it off with 'career first.' My girlfriends flaunt their partners and children, and I like their posts while feeling sour. When I go home to my empty apartment at night, I always feel that life is missing a bit of color, a bit of my own little spark. I saw some Bitcoin in my social media and bought a little, but I just left it there. I always felt that it was a 'risky game for men,' with big fluctuations and high risks. As a workaholic, I have neither the time nor the courage to get involved; just going to work and working overtime is exhausting enough.

Overall, Ethereum’s structure remains constructive and bullish. The combination of a strong impulse move, shallow correction, and confirmed breakout suggests that buyers are still in control.
